title: An RSK correspondence for cylindric tableaux
summary: This paper establishes an analogue of the Robinson--Schensted correspondence for cylindric tableaux. In particular, for any pair of positive integers $(d,L)$, we construct a bijection between permutations that avoid the patterns $d\cdots 1 (d+1)$ and $1\cdots (L+1)$ and pairs of $(d,L)$-cylindric standard Young tableaux with a common shape. This arises as a special case of a Knuth-type generalization involving cylindric semistandard tableaux and a further generalization involving oscillating tableaux.
